npc.speaker: [NPC] Torrhus Canyon
npc.source: The second island of Galatea - Torrhus Canyon, is here!
npc.translation: The second island of Galatea - Torrhus Canyon、ここにあるよ！
npc.encodedSource: The second island of <t0>Galatea</t0> <s0>- </s0><s1>Torrhus Canyon</s1><s2>, is here!</s2>
npc.encodedTranslation: The second island of <t0>Galatea</t0> <s0>- </s0><s1>Torrhus Canyon</s1><s2>、ここにあるよ！</s2>

npc.speaker: [NPC] Torrhus Canyon
npc.source: I saw it on the horizon this morning and made my way over.
npc.translation: 今朝、地平線にそれを見て、向かって行ったんだ。
npc.encodedSource: I saw it on the horizon this morning and made my way over.
npc.encodedTranslation: 今朝、地平線にそれを見て、向かって行ったんだ。

npc.speaker: [NPC] Torrhus Canyon
npc.source: Between Miria’s Contests, the Critter Safari, Torrhus Sea Creatures, and the new Collections, there's so much to do!
npc.translation: の間にMiria’s Contests、Critter Safari、Torrhus Sea Creatures、そして新しいCollections、やることがたくさんあるよ！
npc.encodedSource: <s0>Between </s0><s1>Miria’s Contests</s1>, the <s2>Critter Safari</s2>, <s3>Torrhus Sea Creatures</s3>, and the new <s4>Collections</s4>, there's so much to do!
npc.encodedTranslation: <s0>の間に</s0><s1>Miria’s Contests</s1>、<s2>Critter Safari</s2>、<s3>Torrhus Sea Creatures</s3>、そして新しい<s4>Collections</s4>、やることがたくさんあるよ！

npc.speaker: [NPC] Torrhus Canyon
npc.source: If you want to check it out for yourself, you can access it from the Launch Pad over in the Moonglade Marsh.
npc.translation: 自分で確かめたいなら、Launch Pad over in the Moonglade Marshからアクセスできるよ。
npc.encodedSource: If you want to check it out for yourself, you can access it from the <s0>Launch Pad </s0><s1>over in the </s1><s2>Moonglade Marsh</s2><s3>.</s3>
npc.encodedTranslation: 自分で確かめたいなら、<s0>Launch Pad </s0><s1>over in the </s1><s2>Moonglade Marsh</s2><s3>からアクセスできるよ。</s3>

npc.speaker: [NPC] Torrhus Canyon
npc.source: Happy hunting!
npc.translation: 狩り、楽しんでね！
npc.encodedSource: Happy hunting!
npc.encodedTranslation: 狩り、楽しんでね！

npc.speaker: [NPC] Liz
npc.source: Welcome to the Trade Center!
npc.translation: ようこそTrade Center！
npc.encodedSource: Welcome to the <s0>Trade Center</s0><s1>!</s1>
npc.encodedTranslation: ようこそ<s0>Trade Center</s0><s1>！</s1>

npc.speaker: [NPC] Liz
npc.source: Sorry, but there's... not much to see here right now.
npc.translation: ごめん、でも今はここに見るものはあんまりないんだ。
npc.encodedSource: Sorry, but there's... not much to see here right now.
npc.encodedTranslation: ごめん、でも今はここに見るものはあんまりないんだ。

npc.speaker: [NPC] Liz
npc.source: We're friends of Diaz's, so we only really have stuff to do when she's elected as Mayor with the Stock Exchange perk, haha.
npc.translation: 私たちはDiazの友達だから、彼女がMayorに選ばれてStock Exchangeの特典が付くときだけ、本当にやることがあるんだ、はは。
npc.encodedSource: <s0>We're friends of </s0><s1>Diaz</s1>'s, so we only really have stuff to do when she's elected as <s2>Mayor </s2>with the <s3>Stock Exchange </s3>perk, haha.
npc.encodedTranslation: <s0>私たちは</s0><s1>Diaz</s1>の友達だから、彼女が<s2>Mayor</s2>に選ばれて<s3>Stock Exchange</s3>の特典が付くときだけ、本当にやることがあるんだ、はは。

npc.speaker: [NPC] Liz
npc.source: Try dropping by another time!
npc.translation: また別の時に来てね！
npc.encodedSource: Try dropping by another time!
npc.encodedTranslation: また別の時に来てね！

npc.speaker: [NPC] Farmhand
npc.source: Welcome to The Barn!
npc.translation: ようこそ The Barn へ！
npc.encodedSource: Welcome to The Barn!
npc.encodedTranslation: ようこそ The Barn へ！

npc.speaker: [NPC] Farmhand
npc.source: Feel free to harvest any crops on the island, I'm taking a break.
npc.translation: 島の作物は好きなだけ収穫していいよ、今は休憩中だから。
npc.encodedSource: Feel free to harvest any crops on the island, I'm taking a break.
npc.encodedTranslation: 島の作物は好きなだけ収穫していいよ、今は休憩中だから。

npc.speaker: [NPC] Farmhand
npc.source: Did you craft a Wheat Minion yet? Here's the recipe!
npc.translation: 作った？Wheat Minion これがレシピだよ！
npc.encodedSource: <s0>Did you craft a </s0><s1>Wheat Minion</s1> yet? Here's the recipe!
npc.encodedTranslation: <s0>作った？</s0><s1>Wheat Minion</s1> これがレシピだよ！

npc.speaker: [NPC] Farmer Jon
npc.source: I've been living on this island for 10 years.
npc.translation: この島に10年住んでいるんだ。
npc.encodedSource: I've been living on this island for <n0/> years.
npc.encodedTranslation: この島に<n0/>年住んでいるんだ。

npc.speaker: [NPC] Farmer Jon
npc.source: Before that, I used to compete in sugar cane contests.
npc.translation: その前は、サトウキビコンテストに出場してたんだ。
npc.encodedSource: Before that, I used to compete in sugar cane contests.
npc.encodedTranslation: その前は、サトウキビコンテストに出場してたんだ。

npc.speaker: [NPC] Farmer Jon
npc.source: I've now retired to this house to live out the rest of my days.
npc.translation: もうこの家に引退して、残りの人生を過ごすことにしたんだ。
npc.encodedSource: I've now retired to this house to live out the rest of my days.
npc.encodedTranslation: もうこの家に引退して、残りの人生を過ごすことにしたんだ。

npc.speaker: [NPC] Jake
npc.source: Hi I'm Jake. I've been living on this island for 25 years.
npc.translation: やあ、俺はジェイクだ。25年この島に住んでるよ。
npc.encodedSource: Hi I'm Jake. I've been living on this island for <n0/> years.
npc.encodedTranslation: やあ、俺はジェイクだ。<n0/>年この島に住んでるよ。

npc.speaker: [NPC] Jake
npc.source: I used to study animals from all over the land!
npc.translation: 昔はこの土地のあちこちの動物を研究してたんだ！
npc.encodedSource: I used to study animals from all over the land!
npc.encodedTranslation: 昔はこの土地のあちこちの動物を研究してたんだ！

npc.speaker: [NPC] Jake
npc.source: Unfortunately, I suffered an injury which restricts me from leaving my house.
npc.translation: 残念だけど、怪我をして家から出られなくなっちゃったんだ。
npc.encodedSource: Unfortunately, I suffered an injury which restricts me from leaving my house.
npc.encodedTranslation: 残念だけど、怪我をして家から出られなくなっちゃったんだ。

npc.speaker: [NPC] Jake
npc.source: I really enjoyed studying animals.
npc.translation: 動物の研究が本当に楽しかったよ。
npc.encodedSource: I really enjoyed studying animals.
npc.encodedTranslation: 動物の研究が本当に楽しかったよ。

npc.speaker: [NPC] Jake
npc.source: Could you bring me an animal? You can find them all over the island!
npc.translation: 動物を持ってきてくれる？島のあちこちにいるよ！
npc.encodedSource: Could you bring me an animal? You can find them all over the island!
npc.encodedTranslation: 動物を持ってきてくれる？島のあちこちにいるよ！

npc.speaker: [NPC] Hunter Ava
npc.source: I'm hunting an Elusive animal.
npc.translation: エルーシブな動物を狩っているんだ。
npc.encodedSource: I'm hunting an <s0>Elusive </s0>animal.
npc.encodedTranslation: <s0>エルーシブな</s0>動物を狩っているんだ。

npc.speaker: [NPC] Hunter Ava
npc.source: If you want to hunt animals too, go talk to Trevor!
npc.translation: もし動物狩りもしたいなら、トレバーに話しかけてみて！
npc.encodedSource: If you want to hunt animals too, go talk to Trevor!
npc.encodedTranslation: もし動物狩りもしたいなら、トレバーに話しかけてみて！

npc.speaker: [NPC] Hunter Ava
npc.source: You can find him just past the bridge in his den.
npc.translation: 橋を越えた先の彼の巣で見つけられるよ。
npc.encodedSource: You can find him just past the bridge in his den.
npc.encodedTranslation: 橋を越えた先の彼の巣で見つけられるよ。

npc.speaker: [NPC] Offea
npc.source: My husband works all the time.
npc.translation: うちの夫はずっと働いてるんだ。
npc.encodedSource: My husband works all the time.
npc.encodedTranslation: うちの夫はずっと働いてるんだ。

npc.speaker: [NPC] Mazakala
npc.source: Nonsense...
npc.translation: くだらない…
npc.encodedSource: Nonsense...
npc.encodedTranslation: くだらない…

npc.speaker: [NPC] Mazakala
npc.source: The appearance of that strange disturbance on the nearby island might have nothing to do with time travel.
npc.translation: 近くの島で起きたあの奇妙な乱れは、タイムトラベルとは関係ないかもしれないね。
npc.encodedSource: The appearance of that strange disturbance on the nearby island might have nothing to do with time travel.
npc.encodedTranslation: 近くの島で起きたあの奇妙な乱れは、タイムトラベルとは関係ないかもしれないね。

npc.speaker: [NPC] Mazakala
npc.source: That doesn't mean we should ignore it, someone needs to...
npc.translation: それは無視すべきだという意味ではない、誰かが…
npc.encodedSource: That doesn't mean we should ignore it, someone needs to...
npc.encodedTranslation: それは無視すべきだという意味ではない、誰かが…

npc.speaker: [NPC] Mazakala
npc.source: Can't you see we are busy?
npc.translation: 忙しいのが見えないの？
npc.encodedSource: Can't you see we are busy?
npc.encodedTranslation: 忙しいのが見えないの？

npc.speaker: [NPC] Arba
npc.source: Everyone knows time travel is a myth!
npc.translation: 誰もがタイムトラベルは神話だって知ってるよ！
npc.encodedSource: Everyone knows time travel is a myth!
npc.encodedTranslation: 誰もがタイムトラベルは神話だって知ってるよ！

npc.speaker: [NPC] Arba
npc.source: Excuse me, can't you see we are trying to have a conversation here?
npc.translation: すみません、ここで会話しようとしているのが見えませんか？
npc.encodedSource: Excuse me, can't you see we are trying to have a conversation here?
npc.encodedTranslation: すみません、ここで会話しようとしているのが見えませんか？

npc.speaker: [NPC] Arbadak
npc.source: Just because you don't understand something doesn't mean it's not possible!
npc.translation: 分からないからって、できないってことじゃないよ！
npc.encodedSource: Just because you don't understand something doesn't mean it's not possible!
npc.encodedTranslation: 分からないからって、できないってことじゃないよ！

npc.speaker: [NPC] Arbadak
npc.source: Not even a century ago teleportation was thought to be impossible!
npc.translation: ほんの100年足らず前にはテレポートは不可能だと思われてたんだ！
npc.encodedSource: Not even a century ago teleportation was thought to be impossible!
npc.encodedTranslation: ほんの100年足らず前にはテレポートは不可能だと思われてたんだ！

npc.speaker: [NPC] Arbadak
npc.source: And you yourself are capable of telepathy and telekinesis, which nobody knew were even possible recently!
npc.translation: そして君自身はテレパシーとテレキネシスができるんだ。最近までそれが可能だなんて誰も知らなかったんだ！
npc.encodedSource: And you yourself are capable of telepathy and telekinesis, which nobody knew were even possible recently!
npc.encodedTranslation: そして君自身はテレパシーとテレキネシスができるんだ。最近までそれが可能だなんて誰も知らなかったんだ！

npc.speaker: [NPC] Arbadak
npc.source: Oh, who are you?
npc.translation: あれ、あなたは誰？
npc.encodedSource: Oh, who are you?
npc.encodedTranslation: あれ、あなたは誰？

npc.speaker: [NPC] Arbadak
npc.source: Can you not disturb our conversation?
npc.translation: 会話を邪魔しないでくれる？
npc.encodedSource: Can you not disturb our conversation?
npc.encodedTranslation: 会話を邪魔しないでくれる？

npc.speaker: [NPC] Seffea
npc.source: I love Rhanora's cats, but she wont let me play with any of them!
npc.translation: Rhanoraの猫が大好きだけど、彼女は全然遊ばせてくれないんだ！
npc.encodedSource: I love <s0>Rhanora's </s0>cats, but she wont let me play with any of them!
npc.encodedTranslation: <s0>Rhanoraの</s0>猫が大好きだけど、彼女は全然遊ばせてくれないんだ！

npc.speaker: [NPC] Seffea
npc.source: I wonder if she will notice if one goes missing...
npc.translation: 彼女は誰かがいなくなると気づくかな…
npc.encodedSource: I wonder if she will notice if one goes missing...
npc.encodedTranslation: 彼女は誰かがいなくなると気づくかな…

npc.speaker: [NPC] Krevius
npc.source: DO YOU WANT TO BE PULVERIZED?
npc.translation: 粉砕されたいのか？
npc.encodedSource: DO YOU WANT TO BE PULVERIZED?
npc.encodedTranslation: 粉砕されたいのか？

npc.speaker: [NPC] Grelius
npc.source: DO YOU WANT TO BE PULVERIZED?
npc.translation: 粉砕されたいのか？
npc.encodedSource: DO YOU WANT TO BE PULVERIZED?
npc.encodedTranslation: 粉砕されたいのか？

npc.speaker: [NPC] Queen Nyx
npc.source: The Mage Faction is growing, we will soon uncover all the secrets of Mana.
npc.translation: 魔法使い派閥が勢いを増していて、すぐにManaのすべての秘密を解き明かすよ。
npc.encodedSource: The Mage Faction is growing, we will soon uncover all the secrets of <t0>Mana</t0>.
npc.encodedTranslation: 魔法使い派閥が勢いを増していて、すぐに<t0>Mana</t0>のすべての秘密を解き明かすよ。

npc.speaker: [NPC] Krevius
npc.source: WE HAVE OUR EYES ON YOU.
npc.translation: 目を光らせているよ。
npc.encodedSource: WE HAVE OUR EYES ON YOU.
npc.encodedTranslation: 目を光らせているよ。

npc.speaker: [NPC] Grelius
npc.source: WE HAVE OUR EYES ON YOU.
npc.translation: 目を光らせているよ。
npc.encodedSource: WE HAVE OUR EYES ON YOU.
npc.encodedTranslation: 目を光らせているよ。

npc.speaker: [NPC] Queen Nyx
npc.source: I can sense great power in you.
npc.translation: あなたからすごい力を感じるよ。
npc.encodedSource: I can sense great power in you.
npc.encodedTranslation: あなたからすごい力を感じるよ。
